data.long_meaning: One who guards, protects, and fights for justice and righteousness. The name Pasban carries the meaning “Protector, Warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Pasban usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the divine protector and guardian, Allah, for a child who embodies the qualities of bravery, courage, and unwavering commitment
data.etymology: Pasban belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pasban total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hindi.long_meaning: पासबान नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है रक्षक, संरक्षक या प्रहरी। इस नाम की जड़ें इस्लामी संस्कृति में गहराई से जुड़ी हुई हैं और यह नाम न केवल सुंदर है, बल्कि इसके अर्थ भी बहुत गहरे और महत्वपूर्ण हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, पासबान नाम बच्चों के लिए एक लोकप्रिय विकल्प है क्योंकि यह सुरक्षा और देखभाल की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_english.name: Pasban
in_english.long_meaning: Pasban is derived from Arabic roots, specifically from 'b-s-b-n', which convey the meaning of a guardian, protector, or watchman. This name has significant etymological roots in Islamic tradition and is referenced in the Quran in contexts related to self-protection and guardianship. The name Pasban symbolizes strong values of protection, care, and responsibility, making it a cherished choice among Muslim communities worldwide for their children.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Pasban" holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic society as it signifies a person who is devoted to safeguarding the values, beliefs, and traditions of the community. This can range from protecting physical assets, such as properties and institutions, to championing for social and moral issues that are in line with Islamic teachings. The name embodies the spirit of courage and perseverance, inspiring individuals to stand up for what is right and just, and to defend against any form of harm or negligence towards their religion and community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Pasban" resonates with the Concept of "Amr bil Ma'ruf" and "Nahi anil Munkar," which are two fundamental principles in Islam. These principles illustrate the importance of enjoining good and forbidding evil. A person bearing the name "Pasban" is called upon to fulfill this commitment by actively seeking to create a pure and virtuous environment for themselves and those around them. On a deeper level, this name can serve as a constant reminder to maintain a strong moral compass and to strive towards virtuous actions, thereby seeking the pleasure of Allah (SWT) and ensuring spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector, Warrior" symbolizes One who guards, protects, and fights for justice and righteousness. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Pasban serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector, warrior.
